usage: Repo should have branch protection with required signed commits
name: Protected branches should require signed commits
description: Signing commits is a stronger guarantee that a commit was done by a developer.
detailedDescription: Signing commits is needed because it is pretty easy to add anyone as the author of a commit. Git allows a committer to change the author of a commit easily. In the case of a signed commit, any change to the author will make the commit appear unsigned.

args.name: RepoType
args.label: Repo Type
args.tooltip: Choose if the policy applies to private, public or all repo types.
